g.text: Cross-substation comparison (provisional: past weather, screening run)

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: the pinned vintage capacity and the two fitted capacities side by side; the fitted capacity is not a measurement. Middle: weekend over weekday heating slope. Bottom: dot, the threshold with the lowest loss; line, thresholds within 2 effective nats of it; orange dashed rule, B0's 15.5 C. Weakly identified at real noise levels (experiment 113); compare across substations with care.'
text.tspan: Top: the pinned vintage capacity and the two fitted capacities side by side; the fitted
capacity is not a measurement. Middle: weekend over weekday heating slope. Bottom: dot,
the threshold with the lowest loss; line, thresholds within 2 effective nats of it; orange
dashed rule, B0's 15.5 C. Weakly identified at real noise levels (experiment 113); compare
